### Summary

`<RouterView v-slot="{ Component }">` is reported as resolving to `any` / `unknown`. vue-router 5.3.1 types the slot props as `{ Component: VNode; route: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded }`.

### Version

- `vize` 0.443.0 (npm, bundled `@typescript/typescript-darwin-arm64` 7.0.2)
- Node v26.10.0, macOS arm64

`vize check` reports no type errors for the same file.

### Reproduction

`vize.config.json`

```json
{
  "linter": {
    "preset": "opinionated",
    "typeAware": true
  }
}
```

`tsconfig.json`

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ESNext",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "strict": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "lib": ["ESNext", "DOM"]
  },
  "include": ["*.vue", "*.ts"]
}
```

`RouterViewSlot.vue`

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RouterView } from "vue-router";
</script>

<template>
  <RouterView v-slot="{ Component }">
    <component :is="Component" />
  </RouterView>
</template>
```

`vize lint --format plain RouterViewSlot.vue`

```
  RouterViewSlot.vue:6:23 warning type/no-unsafe-template-binding Template directive expression resolves to an unsafe `any` or `unknown` type
```
